verdict: Bihun sup is more weight-loss friendly. It has half the calories of mee goreng mamak.
why: Bihun sup is an estimated 300 kcal. Mee goreng mamak is an estimated 600 kcal.
Bihun sup fat is an estimated 7 g, mee goreng mamak 23 g, because of the oil used for frying.
Mee goreng mamak is slightly higher in protein (an estimated 18 g vs 15 g). But you can add chicken or fishballs to bihun sup for more protein.
Hot soup makes you eat more slowly and feel full faster.
when_a: Bihun sup suits a light breakfast, lunch or dinner, especially on workdays.
when_b: Mee goreng mamak is okay for an occasional late-night lepak. Add an egg and choose a sugar-free drink.
tip: For bihun sup, ask for extra chicken, egg or fishballs so the protein is higher and you don't get hungry quickly.

faq.q: Is bihun sup alone enough to fill me up?
faq.a: For some people, no. Add protein like chicken or egg, and vegetables if available.

faq.q: So mee goreng mamak is totally off-limits?
faq.a: No, you can have it. Eat a normal plate, less oil, and balance it with lighter meals that day.
